heroEyebrow: The world doesn't need more learners.
heroSub: Sawa is a builder community for young people in the Middle East who want to stop consuming and start creating. Real projects. Real momentum. Real people beside you.
problem1: You watch tutorials. You bookmark threads. You 'plan to start.'
problem3: It's not a knowledge problem. It's a doing problem.
visionText: Sawa is not a course platform. It's a builder ecosystem. Quest-based paths instead of lessons. Live cohorts instead of lonely videos. AI as a tool, not a replacement for thinking. You don't graduate. You level up.
how1Desc: Enter a live room with builders moving at the same pace, with a clear deadline and real energy.
how2Desc: Move through structured missions that turn ideas into shipped work instead of endless planning.
how3Desc: Finish one quest, unlock the next, and build a real identity through repetition.
feature1Desc: Short, intense missions. Ship something real every few days.
feature2Desc: Build alongside others. Get unstuck in minutes, not hours.
feature3Desc: Learn to use AI to build faster, not to avoid thinking.
feature4Desc: Explorer → Creator → Builder → Collaborator → Mentor. Earn it.
notCourseNo3: No hiding alone behind a saved playlist
notCourseYes1: Live cohorts that notice if you disappear
notCourseYes2: Structured quests that end in something real
notCourseYes3: A path that changes your identity through shipping
firstQuestSub: This is where you start. Not where you end.
firstQuestDesc: 3 days. No code. Your first real project on the internet.
for1: I want to build things but I don't know where to start
for2: I have ideas but no technical skills
mentorBio: Built 2 startups. Taught 100+ students. Now building builders.
